<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR. Solve one problem. Features and ABI or engine-patch
changes need a maintainer's yes in an issue first. Use a plain title, such as
"fix(host): broken counters no longer drop their state".
-->

## Problem

<!-- One or two sentences: what is wrong, how to reproduce it, what should happen instead. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes it. If it touches several parts (api, host, mods, engine patch, scripts),
say why each is needed for this one fix. -->

## Scope

<!-- Link the issue. For a small fix of an obvious bug, say why it needs no issue. For a
feature or an ABI change, link the maintainer's yes. -->

## Verification

<!-- The tests, scenarios or measurements you ran and what you saw: paste log lines or numbers.
State anything you could not check. "Tests pass" alone is not enough. -->
